raw_segments.text: I did try, but was presently swept off the stool and denominated, a little bungler.
Being pushed unceremoniously to one side, which was precisely what I wished, he usurped
my place and proceeded to accompany himself, for he could play as well as sing.
I hide me to the window recess, and while I sat there and looked out on the stilled
breeze and dim lawn, to a sweet air was sung in mellow tones the following strain.
